items: [Complete 7-Piece Outdoor Sectional Set] Includes 6 modular sofas + 1 coffee table with tempered glass top. This patio couch set offers 3.15-inch thick seat cushions and 7-inch thick back pillow for all-day comfort. Rearrange into l shaped patio couch, conversation sets, or multiple layouts—perfect for backyard gatherings of any size. Glass table top resists stains and wipes clean easily.

[All-Weather PE Rattan & Breathable Hollow Weave] Geometric hollow weave makes this wicker patio set lightweight, easy to move, and highly breathable. PE rattan offers natural elasticity, resists cracking, dries quickly,Anti-cracking, anti-fading, and is UV-protected—ideal backyard patio furniture that withstands sun, rain, and humidity without yearly staining or sealing.

[Easy-Clean & Low-Maintenance Design] Crafted from upgraded PE rattan; simply wipe the frame clean with a damp cloth—water-resistant and moisture-proof. Removable seat cushion covers are machine washable for effortless care. Unlike solid wood, this outdoor furniture sets requires no regular upkeep, making it a reliable patio furniture set for any home.

[Bohemian Style & Versatile Arrangements] Vintage-style rattan finish + black painted legs + cream cushions create a retro aesthetic. The 6 modular sofas can be arranged into multiple 3-4 person patio conversation set, L-shaped outdoor couch, or sectional layouts—adapting to any gathering size or theme. Perfect for patios, gardens, balconies, and indoor spaces.

[Comfort-Focused Design for All Family Sizes] Features 7-inch thick back pillows and 3.15-inch plush cushions—the ideal outdoor sofa set for lasting comfort, both filled with high-resilience PP cotton. With a 23.6-inch seat depth, even taller users enjoy full thigh support without knee strain—a thoughtful outdoor sofa patio furniture design that keeps everyone comfortable.

[Raised Black Painted Legs – Style & Function] Elevated black-painted legs make sweeping underneath quick and easy, while improving airflow to prevent dampness. The sleek black finish adds modern sophistication that pairs beautifully with vintage. A stylish high-leg design that enhances any outdoor sectional sofas arrangement—perfect for decks, porches, and outside couch setups.

items.value: Attach legs with screws. Tighten using the provided tool. Insert dowels into pre-drilled holes. Align panels and secure with bolts.
